method: FPS=count/sum(raw intervals)*1000; nearest-rank per-run percentiles; median and full min/max across repetitions, no pooling of percentiles.
limits: Three repetitions per main backend; WebGPU-fast is one exploratory repetition with one avatar only.

Same full production content, medium, HUD, 2040x986 CSS/internal, fixed QA weather and UTC1792188000000. Shared sky compatibility change applies to both APIs; this is not the unchanged historical4188 build.
Browser/driver caches were not cleared. First F means first user activation in a new Game, after normal startup preparation.
WebGL preparation completed; every measured WebGPU preparation hit its existing30s watchdog. This compares current end-to-end behavior, not equally completed warmup.
OFF is near the display presentation ceiling around60Hz. Small FPS differences cannot establish unrestricted throughput.
GPU checkpoints reached82-83C; observed graphics clocks varied1088-1379MHz. Thermal/clock conditions were not fixed; small differences cannot be attributed solely to the backend.
Movement uses the same real3sW/3sS inputs but achieved trajectories differ under stalls/corrections. Ambient transit follows real time; camera/astronomy fixture does not freeze it.

WebGL identifies GTX1060/ANGLE D3D11; WebGPU exposes nvidia/pascal only. Host inventory contains one NVIDIA adapter, GTX1060. WebGPU precise device name and actual framebuffer sample query were unavailable.
Whole-frame WebGL GPU timing is not comparable to WebGPU main-pass timing; missing values remain null.
First WebGPU F has one directly proven4.9-5.2s render/LongTask block and another long presentation interval not explained by the measured callback. The second gap's cause is not isolated.
No current NCM bundle rebuild/reuse distribution was collected, no nativeWGSL rewrite or alternative cache architecture was tested.
Initial shader-validation failure and background1FPS smoke were excluded before the measured series; all raw failures remain preserved.
